title: Excel Expert Picks
subtitle: 21 free YouTube lessons from leading Excel teachers, matched to the Excel for Service Delivery course.
description: A hand-picked playlist for learners who want a second explanation in English. Each section matches a section of Excel for Service Delivery.
Every video was checked to be real and embeddable. Videos play from YouTube. The length of each video is shown on YouTube.
outcomes: Hear each core Excel skill explained a second way, in English
Go deeper on XLOOKUP, IF logic, PivotTables and charts
Pick up time-saving tips from Microsoft MVPs and top Excel teachers
requirements: Works best alongside Excel for Service Delivery
audience: Anyone taking Excel for Service Delivery
English speakers who want a quick Excel refresher
